# The Senior

> > Australia's senior-focused local business directory and digital newspaper archive, connecting older Australians with trusted trades, services, and community resources across NSW, VIC, SA, QLD, and WA.

The Senior provides comprehensive business listings tailored for Australian seniors, featuring verified local trades and services including aged care facilities, home maintenance, technology support, and community services. The platform also maintains digital newspaper archives dating back to 2012 across multiple Australian states.

## Key Topics

- Local business directory for seniors
- Australian aged care services
- Home maintenance and trades
- NSW, VIC, SA, QLD, WA regional coverage
- Tuggerah and regional NSW services
- Verified business listings
- Senior-focused IT support (ElderCareTech)
- Retirement living and community care
- Digital newspaper archives
- Property maintenance services
- Building and construction contractors
- Auto repair and cleaning services
- Business verification program
- Regional Australian communities

## Business Directory Overview

- [Local Business Listings - The Senior](https://www.thesenior.com.au/local-business): Main business directory featuring NSW trades & services for seniors across Australia
- [Local Business Listings - The Senior](https://local.thesenior.com.au/): Regional business directory for NSW locations including Tuggerah & Prestons
- [Latest Print Ads - The Senior](https://www.thesenior.com.au/local-business/directory/latest/ads): Current print classifieds for home services & trades across Australia
- [Latest Offers - The Senior](https://www.thesenior.com.au/local-business/directory/latest/offers): Special offers from aged care & senior service providers
- [Verify Your Business – The Senior](https://www.thesenior.com.au/local-business/directory/verify/promote): Business verification & promotion service with Verified Blue badge program
